Writ seeking compulsory observance of 8 days rejected
2018-01-08T14:12:01+06:00 | Star Online Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/country/writ-seeking-compulsory-observance-8-days-liberation-war-national-mourning-day-bangabandhu-rejected-1516720

The High Court (HC) today rejected a writ petition seeking its order on the authorities concerned to ensure that eight particular days are observed by all political parties and citizens .

The HC bench of Justice Quazi Reza-Ul Hoque and Justice Mohammad Ullah passed the rejection order saying that this court is not entitled to order citizens and political parties for observance of the eight particular days by force. The parliament can ensure observance of the days, it says. The eight days include the National Mourning Day, Mujibnagar Day, Victory Day, Independence Day, Intellectual Killing Day, Jail Killing Day on November 3.

Writ petition  seeks compulsory observance of eight days
